title: China's 71m Buddha Didn't Survive 1,200 Years by Luck | China Travel Expert
description:
Everyone thinks the Leshan Giant Buddha survived 1,200 years by luck. It didn't — it was engineered.

Carved into a Sichuan cliff over roughly 90 years (completed 803 CE), the 71-metre Leshan Giant Buddha is the largest stone Buddha on Earth. Hidden drainage channels run through its 1,021 spiralled hair curls, behind its ears and inside the folds of its robe — quietly carrying rainwater off the soft sandstone so it doesn't wash away. That buried plumbing is a big reason it's still standing.

🧭 Expert Tip: See it from the river cruise — the boat frames the whole 71 m figure, no single-file cliff staircase.

乐山大佛不是靠运气挺过1200年——藏在发髻里的排水系统，才是它屹立千年的关键。
